title: Birdie’s Nest | Spacious 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Birdie’s Nest is a designer Seagrove retreat with a large private pool, fire pit, carriage house, bikes, and quick access to the beach and Seaside.
description_expanded: Birdie's Nest Designer Retreat with Private Pool and Carriage House Near Seaside Home Introduction Escape to Birdie's Nest , a beautifully designed coastal retreat in the heart of Seagrove . Featuring a private pool, separate carriage house, and multiple outdoor living spaces , this upscale home offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and prime location just minutes from the beach and Seaside. Home Highlights Private Pool - 12 by 26 foot pool with sun shelf (heating available October through April for an additional fee) Outdoor Living - Poolside loungers, fire pit seating, cushioned lounge area, and covered patio with swing Screened Patio - Side porch with outdoor daybed and ceiling fan for year-round relaxation Carriage House - Private apartment with full kitchen, laundry, and separate entrance Beach Proximity - 1-minute bike ride to Azalea and Camelia Beach Access with beach service available Taxi Bikes - 4 Taxi bikes included and professionally maintained Gourmet Kitchen - Stainless steel appliances, double oven, wine fridge, stand-alone ice maker Coffee Bar - kCup, drip, espresso, and pour-over options plus grinder and frother Dining Space - Seating for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 Smart Living - Smart TV and Sonos sound system in main living area Outdoor Shower - Enclosed shower near the pool Fenced Backyard - Landscaped yard with gas grill Parking - Driveway parking for 3 vehicles (no garage access, no street parking, no RVs or trailers) Laundry - Washer and dryer available in main home and carriage house No Pets - Strict no-pet policy due to allergies Location Perks 1-minute bike ride to Seagrove Village Market and Surfing Deer 4-minute bike ride to Seaside shopping, dining, and food trucks Less than 1 mile to Publix, The Perfect Pig, and Pizza by the Sea Quick access to nearby beach accesses along Scenic 30A Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for reservations of 10 days or longer (included in your stay) Additional cleanings can be scheduled for an extra fee Pool heating available for an additional fee October through April Garage access is not available Street parking, RVs, and trailers are not permitted No pets allowed due to allergies; violations may result in fees or eviction Concierge services available for beach rentals, grocery delivery, eBikes, and more Nearby construction and community projects may occur; refunds are not provided for related disturbances Home Overview Welcome to Birdie's Nest, where thoughtful design meets laid-back coastal living . Located just one block from the beach and a short bike ride to Seaside , this home offers both convenience and a peaceful neighborhood setting. Inside, the interiors feature soft coastal tones inspired by the Gulf, with comfortable furnishings and inviting spaces throughout. The open living area is perfect for gathering, while the fully equipped kitchen makes cooking and entertaining effortless. Step outside to your private backyard oasis, complete with a pool, sun shelf loungers, fire pit, and multiple seating areas tucked beneath beautiful trees. Whether you are soaking up the sun, enjoying an evening by the fire, or lounging on the screened porch daybed, every space is designed for relaxation. The separate carriage house adds an extra layer of privacy and flexibility, making it ideal for extended family, guests, or a quiet retreat of your own. At Birdie's Nest, you are perfectly positioned to enjoy the best of 30A while having a private, resort-style escape to return to each day.
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | Private entrance to covered patio, TV, reading chair, ceiling fan, ensuite bath with dual vanity sink and walk-in shower with bench seating and handheld shower head
2nd Floor King Suite 2 | TV, reading nook with cushioned bench plus reading chair, ceiling fan, ensuite bath with vanity sink and combination shower/tub with handheld shower head
2nd Floor Guest Suite | Sleeps up to 2 two Queen Beds, TV, reading chair, ceiling fan, ensuite bath with vanity sink and walk-in shower with handheld shower head

Carriage House Apartment | King bed, full kitchen with compact refrigerator, dining area, TV, sofa with attached chaise, washer and dryer, full bath with walk-in shower, private balcony, and private entrance accessed via stairs

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
